name: banshee-monorepo
description: Banshee — Space-weather early warning that wails before solar storms break your GPS (Kiroween 2026).

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace=@banshee/web run build
scripts.build:packages: npm --workspace=@banshee/engine run build && npm --workspace=@banshee/feeds run build && npm --workspace=@banshee/swpc-mcp run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace=@banshee/engine test && npm --workspace=@banshee/feeds test && npm --workspace=@banshee/web test
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@banshee/engine run typecheck && npm --workspace=@banshee/feeds run typecheck && npm --workspace=@banshee/swpc-mcp run typecheck && npm --workspace=@banshee/web run typecheck
